sourceLabel: Source-blind Sep. 12 morning scan + CFB Late Refresh + Sports betting handoff update
notes: Thirteen $1 DraftKings tickets are placement-confirmed. Ryan Wingo 60+ receiving yards at +120 is independently qualified but remains outside Real Card until the user confirms placement. All other results, payouts, grades and confidence remain null.
